title: Jonas AI
description: Jonas AI is an AI-powered German learning platform that creates personalized daily lessons from real-life situations. It combines reading, writing, and roleplay practice with instant feedback, progress tracking, and premium subscription support in a full-stack SaaS app.

title: Forge LLM: Document-Based Model Fine-Tuning Tool
description: My friend and I built this to make fine-tuning language models less of a headache. Upload PDFs, and it automatically extracts the text and generates training data from your documents. Then you can fine-tune models using LoRA - a technique that lets you customize models without needing a supercomputer. The whole workflow from document to trained model is in one place, so you don't have to juggle multiple tools.

title: Offline Wiki: RAG-Powered Knowledge Base
description: I wanted to have Wikipedia access without internet, so I built this offline search system. You can ask it questions about European destinations in natural language, and it'll search through thousands of Wikipedia and Wikivoyage articles to give you answers. Perfect for when you're traveling and don't have data or just want a fast, private way to look things up.

title: Jonas: Your Personal Austrian German Tutor
description: Meet Jonas, a friendly AI chatbot designed to be your personal guide to Austrian German and culture. I built Jonas to be more than just a language app; he's a conversational partner who makes learning feel like chatting with a local. Using a fine-tuned language model and a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system I built with FAISS, Jonas can answer your questions about Austria, explain grammar in a simple way, and teach you everything from classic phrases to modern slang.

title: Song popularity predictor
description: I got curious about what makes songs popular, so I built a model to predict it. Used linear regression on synthetic song data to see which features matter most. Simple project, but it was fun to see what the numbers said about hit songs.

title: Whatsapp Bot
description: A simple WhatsApp bot I threw together using Twilio's API. Nothing fancy, just wanted to experiment with automating messages and see how the Twilio integration works.

title: Austrian Food Price Analysis & Email Automation
description: I dug into Austrian food prices to see how much producers vs consumers are getting squeezed. Analyzed the gap between what producers charge and what we pay at the store using official price data. The numbers tell an interesting story about who's really benefiting.

title: Sales Report Automation
description: Turned a manual, repetitive task into a one-click operation. Takes raw sales data, generates charts and insights automatically, and emails out the reports. Saved me (and probably others) hours of copy-pasting into Excel every week.
